en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 11, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include the Asian Digital Library expanding access to Indian scholarly journals, U.S. federal officials reconsidering a healthcare anti‑discrimination rule, new Australian grant opportunities for disability support, and a retail coalition rewriting accessibility standards to improve inclusive shopping.
